text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A at a gain, then bought it back at a much higher price; taking profits feels good, but I should weigh the stock’s prospects rather than sell just to lock in a gain.","My average cost can distort my judgment. I should decide whether to hold or sell based on what I expect from here, not on avoiding the pain of admitting a losing purchase.","A few profitable sales did not prevent my account value from falling in later periods; I should judge decisions by the portfolio’s overall progress, not by individual realized gains."]}
